# Paths that enforce the gates. A change here can disable a control, so it must
# be a declared intent rather than a side effect of other work.
#
# One extended regular expression per line, matched against paths from
# `git diff --name-only`. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
#
# This list lives in its own file so the pull-request check and the push check
# read the same patterns. Held in the workflow twice, one copy would eventually
# gain a pattern the other lacks, and the half that was forgotten would silently
# stop guarding it.
#
# CI runs the four checks through root package scripts, and each package's
# scripts and configuration decide what those checks read. Rewriting any of them
# can make CI green while running nothing, so the manifests and the test and
# compiler configuration are gates too.

^\.github/workflows/
^\.github/protected-paths\.txt$
^\.gitignore$
^\.gitattributes$
^CLAUDE\.md$
^eslint\.config\.
^tsconfig\.base\.json$
^package\.json$
^pnpm-workspace\.yaml$
^packages/[^/]+/package\.json$
^packages/[^/]+/tsconfig(\.[^/]+)?\.json$
(^|/)vitest\.(config|workspace)\.
^packages/conformance/
^packages/[^/]+/src/.*types\.ts$
^packages/core/src/driver/contract\.ts$
